newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's net internat'l reserves falls to $9.902 bln.
newsitem.headline: Peru's net internat'l reserves falls to $9.902 bln.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said Friday its net international reserves fell to $9.902 billion in the seven days ended July 16 from $9.907 billion the previous week.
The bank said its foreign exchange position, or total liquidity minus short and long-term debt obligations, was $2.124 billion on July 16.
Peru's reserves, which have been recovering steadily since President Alberto Fujimori's government took power in 1990, stood at $8.540 billion at the end of 1996.
